body.coach: The studio leaderboard now fills in after it loads, Brand Kit settings won’t overwrite a saved profile if the card was still blank, and a few booking, certification, and payment-receipt details are tidier — including Book me text that stays readable on a dark brand colour, and Mark paid refusing a zero amount.
body.client: Share cards, the review stars, and Pay your coach are a little easier to use on a phone. Bank transfer references can include letters, and a receipt stays on screen if sending it doesn’t go through.

body.coach: Studio (and complimentary full-access accounts) can now publish a studio page that lists coaches under one gym brand, let clients add a home-screen app with your name and logo, run a studio leaderboard next to team challenges, and optionally hide “Powered by WeightClass”. Pro coaches see a locked preview and can unlock with Studio.
body.client: If your coach is on Studio, you may see a studio leaderboard of first names and last-7-days workouts, and if you add the app to your home screen it can use their studio name and logo. “Powered by WeightClass” stays unless they have chosen to hide it.

body.coach: Pro and Studio (and complimentary full-access accounts) can now list packages and prices on the public profile, let a prospect Book me and join as a client (they pay you by GCash, Maya or bank transfer in the app), collect star reviews from real clients, send branded PB and weekly recap share cards, and set a custom welcome with onboarding questions. Growth coaches see a locked preview and can unlock with Pro. Starter and Growth share cards still use WeightClass branding.
body.client: If your coach is on Pro or Studio, you can leave a star review on their public profile (no name is shown) and share a PB or weekly recap card with their logo. New clients may see a custom welcome and a few extra sign-up questions. Book me on a public profile brings you into the app as their client, where Pay your coach still uses GCash, Maya or bank transfer — no money moves through Autoprod.

body.coach: Growth, Pro and Studio (and complimentary full-access accounts) can now publish a public coach profile, apply a logo and brand colour to the client app, and share a transformations wall after each client agrees. Starter coaches see a locked preview and can unlock with Growth. Autoprod Admin can add a verified-coach badge after certifications are uploaded.
body.client: If your coach has set a logo or brand colour, you'll see it in the app header and on the welcome screen. You can choose whether a before-and-after photo appears on their public profile — it's off until you agree, no name is shown, and you can turn it off any time.

body.coach: You can now add bank details next to GCash and Maya in Settings. Clients see them on Pay your coach, upload a receipt, and you mark it paid as usual. No money moves through Autoprod.
body.client: If your coach has added bank details, they appear on Pay your coach next to GCash and Maya. Upload a receipt after you transfer. No money moves through Autoprod.

body.coach: Clients can now pay you by GCash or Maya in the app, then upload a receipt for you to mark paid or not received. Set your details and a default fee in Settings. Receipt photos stay private. No money moves through Autoprod.
body.client: Pay your coach has a clearer home in the app. Pay by GCash or Maya using your coach's details, upload a receipt, and you'll see when it's marked paid. No money moves through Autoprod.

title: How the plan shows on your bank statement
body: Your WeightClass HQ plan charge appears on your bank statement as LINK.COM* AUTOPROD. You'll also see this note on Your plan.

title: Log your own meals
body: On Home, tap My food to open your own food log. Snap meal is there next to Search food and Barcode, separate from your clients.

title: Sending bar only counts real items
body: The sending bar now only counts logs that can actually be sent to a client. Demo data no longer leaves it stuck on screen.

body.coach: You and your clients can now snap a photo of a meal and we'll estimate the foods and macros. Check the amounts, then save — it goes on the shared food log.
body.client: You can now snap a photo of your meal and we'll estimate the foods and macros. Check the amounts, then save — it goes on your food log for you and your coach.

title: Rate the app
body: You'll find Rate the app in Settings. It's one to five stars and an optional note, and it only appears as a prompt on a calm open – never in the middle of a workout.

title: Exercise names in Progress
body: Exercise names now stay on your past records in Progress, including ones that were typed in rather than picked from the list.

title: Weekly progress reel
body: On Progress, tap Make reel for a short recap of this week — sessions, weight change, PBs and up to two photos. It's made on your phone, so you can share or save it without uploading.

body.coach: You can record a short voice cue (up to 30 seconds) on an exercise when you edit a client's routine. They'll hear it in their workout.
body.client: If your coach leaves a voice cue on an exercise, tap Coach cue in your workout to hear it.

title: Plateau alerts
body: You'll get a card when a client's progress stalls, with a suggested tweak to try.

body.coach: You can set up a steps, streak or workouts challenge between clients. Everyone sees the same live leaderboard.
body.client: If your coach starts a team challenge, you'll see the live leaderboard in your app.

title: Load-light and offline
body: The app keeps working on slow or patchy data. Anything you log while offline is sent when you're back, and you can turn Load-light on in Settings.

body.coach: When you log a workout, food or progress for a client, they now see it in their app, marked From your coach.
body.client: When your coach logs a workout, food or progress for you, it shows in your app as From your coach.

title: Today's track and rewards
body: Today's track moves as you tick off your daily goals, and you can earn rewards for staying consistent.

title: Chat, photos and voice notes
body: Chat now updates as messages arrive, and you can send photos and voice notes.

title: Send feedback
body: There's a Send feedback button in the app if you need to report an issue, raise a concern or suggest an idea.

title: Progress photos from your gallery
body: When you add a progress photo, you can take a new one or upload one from your gallery.

title: Progress photos go to your coach

body.coach: When a client adds a new progress photo, it now appears on their Photos tab automatically. Older photos still on their phone stay private until they tap Share with coach.
body.client: New progress photos are shared with your coach automatically — your coach only, never other clients. Photos already on this phone stay private until you tap Share with coach.
